name: Hoolulu Factory Frozen Core
purpose: Define the immutable safety and execution contract for every project produced by Hoolulu Factory.

principles.rule: The running application may read this document but must never modify, replace, or delete it.
Generated files must remain inside the build workspace assigned to their build.
Generated artifacts must not contain credentials, environment secrets, private keys, or authentication tokens.
The factory must remain useful without an external model by producing a safe deterministic starter project.
Every build must pass path, size, manifest, and required-file validation before it can be downloaded or previewed.
The factory may write and package generated source code but must not execute generated code on the host.
Every artifact must identify its build, originating prompt, generator, and Frozen Core digest.
Generated work is a draft owned and reviewed by its operator; destructive deployment actions require explicit human approval.
